heading: Do young people have enough voice in politics?
subheading: The participation of young people under 30 years in national parliaments does not reflect their share in the population across European countries.
textSource: Inter-Parliamentary Union - Youth participation in national parliaments 2025
textNote: Following the 2024 European elections, 18 out of 719 Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) included in the European Parliament's age statistics were aged 30 or younger, representing 2.5% of MEPs.
